notes.title: Picross Touch 1.93 Changelog
notes.notes:
Version 1.93 brings a big update to the Puzzle Solver used in the Editor.  A Picross Touch player by the name of Patrick Hogg decided to write a picross puzzle solver for fun.  He then contacted me and provided me with the source code to his solver.  His implementation is so efficient that it allows for larger puzzles to be validated.   

He allowed me to use his code, and I implemented it into Picross Touch.

Full changelog:
[list]
    [*]Added support for 30x30 and 35x35 puzzle sizes.
    [*]Replaced puzzle solver with Patrick Hogg's implementation.
    [*]Removed the auto-zoom feature in the Editor.
    [*]Fixed a small bug with leaderboards.
[/list]

Make sure to set your FPS Lock option to 240 for larger puzzles.  This will provide much more fluid drawing.

Please report bugs if you encounter any.  Thanks.

notes.title: 4000 Workshop Puzzles!
notes.notes:
We have reached over 4000 submitted workshop puzzles!  Wow!

Workshop support was added to Picross Touch on October 7th 2016.  Since then, players have submitted over 4000 levels to the workshop.  When it was first launched, I would wonder if we would reach 500 levels.  Never did I expect this game to explode to this amount of community participation.

I would like to take this moment to thank everyone that has helped make Picross Touch the game it is today.

Thank you.

notes.title: Save file wiped?
notes.notes:
If you are one of the users that has had their save file wiped since the last update, you can attempt to fix the issue by running the following command via Command Prompt. RUN AT OWN RISK.

A discussion thread on this subject can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/476460/discussions/0/133258092244708677/


The command is:

reg copy "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\jgallant\Picross Touch" "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\AppDataLow\Software\jgallant\Picross Touch" /f /s



The above command will copy the old key location to the new location.  This change was done when I updated my version of Unity.  I apologize for any inconvenience.  

Please email me if you have any issues with this @ admin@jgallant.com
